mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.7% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.7, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signal a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansion, a rising industrial production index (above 100) signals robust manufacturing activity and strong corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO rises during early-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 240 signals persistent high inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 240, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong job growth (PAYEMS rising) and declining unemployment (UNRATE falling) signal a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls from prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1000 during the post-pandemic recovery signals strong consumer confidence and increased residential investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1000 during the post-pandemic recovery, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
